purpose: Recover the retained production auth-mail worker when its historical Compose authority no longer renders the worker service, by replacing only that worker with the exact current API image under a canonical root-owned stable Compose override.
preconditions: API and Web are one exact current-main revision
exactly one retained auth-mail worker exists in the same Compose project
retained worker is healthy and passes the canonical non-root command, environment, mount and network boundaries
retained worker Compose files render successfully but do not contain auth-mail-worker
target API image and retained worker image are already local and have the expected immutable OCI revisions
root-owned auth-mail runtime projection is valid before mutation
invariants: no database SQL or credential mutation
no SMTP send, registration journey or password reset
canonical worker command and non-root image boundary
four read-only auth-mail runtime mounts only
runtime projection content digest is unchanged
post-mutation worker must be exact target revision, healthy and ready
bounded rollback uses the retained local worker image under the same canonical stable contract
